tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Starts an automated real-browser scan of a public website to check its cookie consent behaviour: cookies and trackers set before consent, whether a consent banner appears, and whether rejecting consent is honoured. Side effect: queues a new scan on GDPR Privacy Monitor, unless the same URL was scann

tools.name: get_scan_result

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Explains a GDPR Privacy Monitor finding type, such as pre_consent_tracker or reject_flow_failed: what was detected, why it matters, and suggested wording for explaining it to the site owner, in the requested language. tools.description: Returns steps to fix a finding type, optionally for a named consent management platform.
